name: Margaret Howell
why: British craft-minimalism's quiet institution — Irish linen, British cottons, and clothes designed to be repaired; the design-world's favorite wardrobe for forty years.
origin: Margaret Howell, London, 1970 — began with a found men's shirt; built a house on British and Irish cloth, functional cut, and permanence. Enormous in Japan.
opview: Her stated creed: good design is about how things work, and clothes should age well.

notes.linen: the Irish linen champion — her signature cloth, celebrated seam by seam
notes.craft: British and Japanese make, repairable construction
notes.style: minimalism with warmth — the design world's uniform

cities: London & Tokyo stores · US via specialty/e-tail

marks: Tencel [licensed]. Zero trademark symbols anywhere in the catalogue. MHL. and London Workroom are NOT fabric names
